policy: Case A only, explicit v1→v2 handoff migration. Preserve the already committed Explorer proposal, unchanged scientific content and all history, 12 cumulative calls and all existing budget/retry limits. Continue with Investigator then Critic(C1→C2); no pre-investigation C1. GLM-4.7-Flash only; B/C/D paused. This continuation is not a fresh independent run or isolated ablation.

acceptance_criterion.primary: At least one A/B case commits nonempty claim-level evidence audits after passing C1. A winning mechanism is not required.
secondary: capability IDs on all new evidence questions
Critic acceptance records for every submitted revision
Investigator predeclared comparison outcomes and advisory information updates
all evidence sources REAL and initial facts unchanged
acceptance_criterion.failure_policy: Stop at frozen limits. No budget escalation, C1 weakening, case substitution or selective omission.

handoff_migration.reason: User authorized Case A continuation in the restored Explorer→Investigator→Critic order. Existing Explorer output is reused; no scientific content is edited.
